title: Dengue fever, medical management
admission_note:
KAVERI CITY HOSPITAL - Department of Internal Medicine
Patient: Meera Iyer, 58 years, female. Contact +91 99452 70188. Policy no. GH-POL-100455 (self).
Fever for 4 days with myalgia and retro-orbital pain. NS1 antigen positive. Platelets 38,000/uL falling from 96,000/uL over 48 hours. Haematocrit 44%.
Provisional diagnosis: dengue fever with thrombocytopenia (ICD-10 A90). Known hypothyroidism on thyroxine.
Plan: admission for monitoring and supportive management for 4 days in a twin-sharing room at Rs 4,000 per day.
Estimate: room Rs 16,000; physician fees Rs 8,000; consumables Rs 3,000; medicines Rs 9,000; investigations Rs 6,000. Total Rs 42,000.
Attached: admission note, cost estimate, NS1 report, platelet trend, ID proof. Treating physician: Dr. Ritu Bhandari.
